affected.note: All IDARE users registered by 2026-09-27, including those who had cancelled. Some users also had ID document numbers, partial card and bank account numbers, and income or employer data (for a lending service closed in 2021) leaked. Login passwords, ID images and full card numbers were not affected.

summary.en: Fivot, operator of the prepaid cashless app IDARE, said a vulnerability in external software used for customer support was exploited and data in its database was taken several times between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-27. Personal data of 129,659 users, including phone numbers, email addresses, balances and transaction histories, leaked.
summary.ja: キャッシュレスアプリ「IDARE」を運営するFivotは、カスタマーサポート業務用の外部ソフトウェアの脆弱性を悪用され、2026年8月10日から9月27日にかけて複数回データベースの情報を取得されたと発表した。電話番号、メールアドレス、残高、取引履歴などを含む129,659人分の個人情報が漏えいした。
